scripts.cms:dry-run: wrangler pages functions build functions --outdir .wrangler/cms-dry-run --project-directory . --build-output-directory public
scripts.cf:typegen: wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts --env-file .dev.vars.example --env-interface CloudflareCmsEnv --include-runtime false --strict-vars false
scripts.dev: npm run d1:migrate:local && wrangler pages dev public --port 4174
scripts.deploy:preview: wrangler pages deploy public --project-name tungphat-cms --branch preview
scripts.deploy:production: wrangler pages deploy public --project-name tungphat-cms --branch main
scripts.d1:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply tung-phat-leads-preview --remote --env preview
